infrastructure_plan: Cloudflare Pages (static) → Cloudflare Workers + D1 (serverless backend, free tier) → VPS (scale when revenue justifies)

phases.description: Deploy all static HTML/CSS/JS pages to Cloudflare Pages. No backend needed. Donations use external hosted payment links.

Nav links work on all pages

steps.name: Revenue-Generating Backend (Workers + D1)
steps.description: Build backend on Cloudflare Workers + D1 database (both free tier). On-site Flutterwave payments, D1 for structured data, admin CRUD tools. Revenue features first — no paid hosting needed.
steps.platform: Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Flutterwave API (all free tier)

Create /api/admin/* CRUD Workers for each table

Add payment to ad booking flow (charge on submit)

Replace hardcoded page data with API-driven content from D1

acceptance_criteria: D1 database accessible from Workers (Pages Functions bindings)
Donations processed on-site via Flutterwave (no external redirect)
Ad bookings accept payment and log to D1
Admin can view / export donation and booking data
Admin can update testimonials, stats, gallery without editing HTML
Everything runs on Cloudflare free tier ($0/mo)

steps.name: Growth & Automation
steps.description: Email automation sequences, analytics dashboards, premium content gate, paid courses. Scale when revenue justifies paid infrastructure.

items: Paid courses or workshops with registration

acceptance_criteria: Automated email sequences run without manual intervention
Admin has full visibility into all metrics
Premium content generates recurring revenue

phases.current_focus: Phase 3 in progress — Step 3.1 done (D1 database live, admin CRUD Workers deployed). Next: Step 3.2 — embed Flutterwave checkout on-site, payment webhook, start accepting donations without external redirects.
notes: Cloudflare Pages is the right starting point — free, fast global CDN, easy HTTPS.
Phases 2-4 build on the same Cloudflare infrastructure using Workers and a backend.
The GAHQ CRM backend already exists locally — deploying it is the main Phase 3 effort.
Don't wait for perfect — deploy Phase 1 now, iterate live.
Roadmap now has auto-verification: checks live files on load, auto-marks done items.
Refactored to industry-standard structure: assets/css/main.css + assets/js/main.js.
404.html added. Gallery images renamed. Roadmap moved to /admin/.
RSS news proxy (Pages Function) replaces rss2json.com — live Ghana news feed.
Books converted to lead magnets (email capture modal via Formspree).
Sales chat widget with animated dice mascot added to donation page.
Mobile UX polish (step 1.9) should be completed before Phase 2 — users judge the site on mobile first.
Phase 1 complete. All deployment blockers fixed, domain secured, admin gated, images compressed, mobile UX optimized.
Phase 2 started: form handler Worker deployed (replaces Formspree), news aggregation Worker live.
Phase 2 complete: KV subscriber storage live. All form submissions persist to KV. Admin can view/export subscribers at /admin/subscribers.html.
Phase 3 pivoted to Cloudflare Workers + D1 (free tier) instead of Railway/Fly.io. Revenue-first: on-site Flutterwave payments, D1 database, admin CRUD. No paid hosting needed.
D1 free tier: 5GB storage, 5M reads/mo, 100k writes/mo — more than enough for early revenue phase.
